description: `--tag` (repeatable, joined with commas on the ntfy `Tags` header) and `--episode-state` (only recorded together with `--episode-key`) ride along on the same no-topic queue path `notify-no-topic-queues-and-flush` pins: no topic file exists, so `ntfy_push` short-circuits before any network call and the record is queued with exit 0 regardless of how many tags or which episode fields were given. `--episode-state` alone, without `--episode-key`, is dropped by the CLI before it ever reaches the queued record (`commands::notify::run_with_state`). `--flush` of the episode-backed first record requeues without attempting the transport when `episodes.json` is missing (`notify.py:1108-1122`, card `20261103-b-51b151`); the second record has no episode fields and still hits the no-topic short-circuit.
